Pong Game

Classic Pong on canvas — rally against the AI paddle, first to 7 wins, with pause and speed-up rallies.

0

To win

Press Start — first to 7 wins!

📖 How to use

  1. Move your paddle with mouse, touch, or ↑/↓.
  2. Return the ball past the AI paddle.
  3. First to 7 points wins.
  4. Rallies speed up — stay sharp!

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I control my paddle?

Mouse, touch-drag, or ↑/↓ arrow keys move your paddle.

How do I win?

First to 7 points wins the match.

How hard is the AI?

The AI tracks the ball with a capped speed — rallies get faster the longer they last.

Can I pause?

Yes — the Pause button freezes the game anytime.
